title: Senate Republicans deepfaked Chuck Schumer, and X hasn’t taken it down
description: The video was posted Friday on the Senate Republicans' X account. According to X’s policies, the platform prohibits “deceptively shar[ing] synthetic or manipulated media that are likely to cause harm.” Harmful content includes media that could “mislead people” or “cause significant confusion on public issues.”
author: Rebecca Bellan
